description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'LegacyCameraConnectionFragment' that manages camera preview functionality, including setup, lifecycle management, and camera configuration, for use within an Android application leveraging deprecated Camera APIs.

classes.name: LegacyCameraConnectionFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing camera preview lifecycle, configuration, and buffer setup, utilizing deprecated Camera API for camera access and previews.

methods.name: LegacyCameraConnectionFragment
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fragment with a preview callback, layout resource, and desired preview size.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view components post view creation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and initiates camera preview setup if texture is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops camera and background thread to release resources.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new HandlerThread for background processing.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops and joins the background thread safely.

methods.name: stopCamera
methods.description: Stops camera preview, releases camera resources.

methods.name: getCameraId
methods.description: Finds and returns the ID of the back-facing camera.
